description: This file defines the TagRepository class, implementing the ITagRepository interface for managing Tag entities in a Flutter application using Firestore. It includes methods for streaming, retrieving, upserting, and deleting tags, handling user identification, and interacting with Firestore collections and documents.

classes.name: ITagRepository
classes.description: Abstract interface defining the contract for Tag repository operations such as streaming, retrieving, upserting, and deleting tags.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ITagRepository interfacing with Firestore to manage Tag entities. It handles user identification and Firestore document/collection interactions.

methods.name: streamTags
methods.description: Returns a stream of lists of Tag objects, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: streamTag
methods.description: Returns a stream of a single Tag object identified by ID, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a Tag by its ID, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a Tag in Firestore and returns its document ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Tag from Firestore by its ID, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: _requireUid
methods.description: Private helper method that ensures a user ID is available, either from parameter or provider, or throws an error.
